review_rules.dispatch: Select explicit indices with --indices 13 15 16 19 --jobs 1. No route controller, ordinary save preload, captures or new body input. 13 and 15 observe only after entry; 16 and 19 reproduce only their documented historical inputs.
review_rules.positions: Groups and absolute records are zero-based. next_position is static CST evidence, not an executed input, a timestamp or a verified reachability result.
review_rules.gate: A future separately authorized Enter requires the matching effective CST, committed current nonempty body, live body window, exact manual wait, no pending messages or handlers and no active blocking transition or movie. Require the same window's new physical Keyboard(13) acceptance and script resume before scoring the next body. A frame trace without the profile or exact marker is observation only.
review_rules.failure_classification: Record explicit engine errors, actual frame stalls, missing required click or key receipts, and running frames with an unrecognized wait separately. Reaching the cap or a zero exit code cannot pass a checkpoint. Nonzero alpha counts are reference evidence, not hardcoded thresholds and not proof of exact text by themselves.
